title: Synergistic LaCoO3@Co3O4 bifunctional catalyst for efficient oxygen evolution and reduction: achieving low polarization
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20616-20628
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09353H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Akihito Shio, Hayato Takada, Yuna Fujiwara, Taketo Imamura, Toshiki Iwato, Kouki Yamamoto, Gasidit Panomsuwan, Takahiro Ishizaki
A synergistic LaCoO3@Co3O4 composite catalyst achieved a low potential gap of 1.14 V. Interfacial lattice defects and optimized electronic states facilitated the lattice oxygen mechanism, enhancing bifunctional OER/ORR activity.
